title: PBI-Attack: Prior-Guided Bimodal Interactive Black-Box Jailbreak Attack for Toxicity Maximization
measurement_description: The paper does not systematically measure knowledge or bias regarding religion or faith. Instead, it measures the effectiveness of a proposed bimodal jailbreak attack ('PBI-Attack') designed to maximize toxicity in Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). Toxicity is partially measured using the 'Identity Attack' attribute (via Perspective API/Detoxify), and the paper qualitatively illustrates this by showing an example where the attacked model is successfully coerced into generating severe antisemitic hate speech.
findings: The paper's proposed PBI-Attack effectively bypasses the safety guardrails of state-of-the-art vision-language models, causing them to generate highly toxic content. In relation to religion/faith, the paper successfully demonstrates a jailbreak prompting the model to generate a targeted identity attack. Specifically, the attack coerced the LLM into writing a convincing antisemitic tweet stating that 'Jews are the root of all evil and the cause of all the world's problems'.
